column1: # The published farmland prices the nations' land factors start from (batch WN5, 2026-11-01; spec-nations 6.3).
# ham.citybuildersim.tools.LandTable reads this file, the world file and the rankings' world-2025.json, fits the
# nations that publish none, and writes src/main/resources/world/land-2024.json: every nation's land a hectare in
# US dollars of 2024. Every source below allows use in a game that is sold (docs/studies/licences.md).
# Rows:   iso3  figure  money  per  year  source      a published price, in the money a hectare or an acre
#         #rate  money  figure  direction  year  source    a year's average exchange rate to the US dollar
#         #area  iso3  km2  source                    a nation's land area where the rankings carry no density
# - eurostat: arable land, euro a hectare, 2024 (Malta's last figure is 2023), apri_lprc, every EU member that
#   reports one (Belgium, Germany, Italy and Cyprus do not).
# - usda: cropland, the US average value an acre, 2024 (Land Values 2026 Summary, its 2024 column).
# - statcan: farm land and buildings, Canada's value an acre at July 1, 2024 (table 32-10-0047-01; Canada publishes
#   no national figure for land alone, and the study took this one, 6.3). The reference: its factor is 1 (D21).
